title: Completed-root OwnClear: recover safely from authority-image supersession without replaying a producer event
outcome: The completed or obsolete root's own-clear path handles a same-context authority-image supersession through supported bounded recovery, while genuine entry, journal, run, reader or ownership changes remain refused and no producer naming event is fabricated.
acceptance: Record a deterministic regression for the completed-root OwnClear supersession seam, distinguishing it from live-held naming and the parent repair; preserve the original natural refusal and do not infer an identical retry succeeded from later background retirement.

Establish the safe existing recovery boundary from source before changing behavior. Any retry reuses the original deadline and bounded policy, revalidates the exact entry, journal, run association, naming-session and reader authority, and emits no new producer naming event; changed or unknown state remains truthfully refused/retained.

Behavioral controls cover same-context progress, genuine supersession or replacement rejection, once-only confirmed retirement/publication and truthful failures, without sleeps, widened timeouts, raw-store access or authority relaxation. Exact-input focused checks, fresh required review pair and final full gate precede landing.
